name: 蘇莉芸
objective: Following the progress of the course of chemistry, introduce chemical engineering students to learn basically operations and techniques for several kinds of devices in the laboratory experiments. This course is designed to train students how to use their brain and hands simultaneously and to settle down their science concepts.
schedule:
Week Date Laboratory Schedule
1 Sep. 7 – Sep. 11 Laboratory rules, group assignment, Safety orientation
2 Sep. 14 – Sep. 18 Safety orientation, Basic laboratory operations
3 Sep. 21 – Sep. 25 Experiment 1: Determination of Density
4 Sep. 28 – Oct. 2 Holiday week (Teachers’ Day Make-up holiday on Sep. 29)
5 Oct. 5 – Oct. 9 Experiment 2: Preparation of Detergent and Analysis of Its Properties
6 Oct. 12 – Oct. 16 Experiment 3: Interfacial Polycondensation – Synthesis of Nylon 66
7 Oct. 19 – Oct. 23 Experiment 4: Paper Chromatography – Separation of Metal Ions
8 Oct. 26 – Oct. 30 Holiday week (Taiwan Retrocession Day on Oct. 26)
9 Nov. 2 – Nov. 6 Experiment 5: Measurement of the Molar Volume of Nitrogen Gas
10 Nov. 9 – Nov. 13 Holiday week (School Anniversary Make-up Holiday on Nov. 9)
11 Nov. 16 – Nov. 20 Dec. 14 – Dec. 18 Experiments 19 & 20: Virtual Laboratory (I) & (II), Session 1 (Room 332, Science and Research Building)
12 Nov. 23 – Nov. 27 Experiments 19 & 20: Virtual Laboratory (I) & (II), Session 2 (Room 332, Science and Research Building)
13 Nov. 30 – Dec. 4 Experiment 6: Determination of Molecular Weight Using Vapor Density
14 Dec. 7 – Dec. 11 Experiment 7: Hydrolysis Reaction and Acid–Base Titration
15 Dec. 14 – Dec. 18 Experiment 8: Distribution of Organic Acids in Water and Organic Solvents
16 Dec. 21 – Dec. 25 Experiment 9: Enthalpy Change in Chemical Reactions and Its Determination
17 Dec. 28 – Jan. 1 Alternative Learning (Final examination week)
18 Jan. 4 – Jan. 8 Alternative Learning (Final examination week)

The schedule is dependent on the actual progress of the lesson.
scorePolicy:
1. Attendance: 20%
General performance: 35%
Pre-lab reports : 20%.
Final reports: 20%.
Weeks 17–18 Compiled Report: 5%
2. Each late arrival will result in a 2-point deduction from the general performance score, and each absence will result in a 10-point deduction.
3. Each meaningful contribution or response in class will add 1 bonus point to the general performance score.
4. Each group must submit the compiled report for Weeks 17–18 to the instructor's office before class in Week 18.
